info.title: Retail Banking Payments API
info.description: Payment initiation and management API exposed by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) for the JRN-002 Faster Payment Initiation journey. Consumed by the channel (SVC-017). Authentication via OAuth 2.0 with PKCE — the channel passes the customer's authenticated session token. All endpoints require a valid session token with the payments:write or payments:read scope.

post.summary: Create a payment intent (initiate a Faster Payment)
post.description:
Creates a PaymentIntent and initiates the asynchronous pre-execution check flow. Must be called after SCA has been completed and a CoP check has been performed. The channel must pass the CoP result and SCA assertion reference in the request body. Returns a 202 Accepted with the payment_intent_id immediately — the caller should then poll GET /payments/{id} for status updates.

**Pre-conditions:**
- Customer session authenticated (OAuth 2.0 Bearer token with payments:write scope)
- CoP check completed by the channel (result included in request body)
- SCA completed with dynamic linking to payee and amount (sca_assertion_ref included)

**Business rules enforced:**
- Account must be in status = active
- Available balance must be >= amount
- amount + daily_payment_total must not exceed daily_payment_limit
- amount must be between 0.01 and 250000.00 GBP (FPS scheme limits)

**Publishes:** PaymentIntentCreated (EVT-P01)

202.description: Payment intent accepted. Pre-execution checks initiated asynchronously. Poll GET /payments/{id} for status.

Location.description: URL of the created payment intent resource

X-Request-Id.description: Idempotency key echoed back — used to deduplicate retried requests

400.description: Validation error — invalid request body, amount out of range, or missing required fields

value.message: Amount must be between 0.01 and 250000.00 GBP
Sort code not found in Vocalink EISCD

402.description: Insufficient funds or daily limit exceeded

value.message: Available balance is insufficient for this payment
This payment would exceed your daily payment limit

403.description: Account not active or customer does not own the account

409.description: Duplicate request — a PaymentIntent with this idempotency key already exists

Location.description: URL of the existing payment intent

get.summary: Get the current status of a payment intent
get.description:
Returns the current status and details of a PaymentIntent. Used by the channel to poll for status updates during asynchronous pre-execution checks and FPS execution. The channel should poll at 1-second intervals. Terminal states (completed, failed, fraud_blocked, sanctions_blocked, cancelled) will not change.

**Note:** fraud_score is not included in the response payload — it is access-controlled to internal systems only. The channel receives risk_level if the payment was fraud-blocked (for internal routing only — never rendered to PER-001).

403.description: Customer does not own this payment intent

post.summary: Cancel a pending or scheduled payment intent
post.description:
Cancels a PaymentIntent that has not yet reached a terminal state. Cancellation is only permitted for payments with status = pending_screening or status = scheduled. Payments with status = processing (PaymentCleared published — FPS submission in progress) cannot be cancelled.

**Publishes:** PaymentFailed with failure_reason = cancelled_by_customer

parameters.name: payment_intent_id
parameters.description: UUID of the PaymentIntent to cancel

409.description: Payment intent cannot be cancelled — it is in a non-cancellable state (processing, completed, failed, fraud_blocked, sanctions_blocked)

example.message: Payment is already processing and cannot be cancelled

403.description: Customer does not own this payment intent

BearerAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token issued by SVC-100 (IAM). Required scopes: payments:write (POST), payments:read (GET). Token must contain sub (customer_id) and account_id claims.

account_id.description: UUID of the source account. Must be owned by the authenticated customer.

amount.description: Payment amount in GBP. Decimal string with exactly 2 decimal places. Range: 0.01–250000.00.

currency.description: Currency code. FPS supports GBP only.

payee_sort_code.description: 6-digit UK sort code of payee account (no hyphens).

payee_name.description: Payee name as entered by the customer. Must match the name used in the CoP check.

payment_reference.description: Optional payment reference. Max 18 characters per FPS scheme rules.

cop_result.description: CoP check result from the channel's call to SVC-009 POST /cop/verify. Must be provided.

cop_override_confirmed.description: Required and must be true when cop_result is partial_match or no_match. Records that the customer actively confirmed intent to proceed despite the mismatch. Omit or false for match/not_available results.

cop_override_timestamp.description: Required when cop_override_confirmed = true. ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the customer's override confirmation.

sca_assertion_ref.description: Reference to the SCA assertion validated by SVC-100. SVC-001 validates this reference against SVC-100 to confirm SCA was completed with dynamic linking for this specific payee and amount.

scheduled_payment_date.description: Optional. If provided, creates a scheduled payment for this date. Must be a future date within 365 days. Omit for immediate payment.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If provided, a duplicate request with the same key within 24 hours returns the existing PaymentIntent rather than creating a new one. Recommended for all production calls.

status.description: Initial status. pending_screening for immediate payments; scheduled for future-dated payments.

poll_url.description: URL to poll for status updates. Equivalent to GET /payments/{payment_intent_id}.

payee_account_number_masked.description: Payee account number with first 4 digits masked as XXXX followed by last 4 digits. E.g. XXXX5678.

fps_reference.description: FPS end-to-end reference. Only present when status = completed.

failure_reason.description: Reason for failure. Only present when status = failed. Note: sanctions_review and fraud-specific reasons are mapped to generic_decline for customer-facing responses — the specific reason is available only in the WORM audit log.

completed_at.description: Timestamp of payment completion. Only present when status = completed.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code for programmatic handling by the channel.

message.description: Human-readable error description for logging. Not for direct display to PER-001 — channel must use localised message copy.

field.description: Field name that caused the validation error (for 400 responses).

current_status.description: Present on CANNOT_CANCEL errors — the current status that prevents cancellation.
